ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Luminous Pigment
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
DEEPFIRE_PIGMENT_MOD_1 (design/RimMandrake/deepfire_luminous_pigment_spec.md, fully ruled 2026-09-25/26). RimMandrake tier — every name here is invented, nothing is Star Wars IP (Q11a). Deepfire is a luminous pigment carried by no colour of its own: mixed with an ordinary dye it makes whatever colour the dye gives glow. It comes from crowncarpet, a rainbow bacterial mat found rarely on any ocean shore.
THIS BUILD (Phase 1 — the chain, spec §2): crowncarpet (wild shore spawn on any ocean, a GenStepDef scatter at low commonality), the one-day fresh-mat clock (dies fast, dies at once if chilled — CompMatVitality), the Deepfire press (a screw press and an alchemical retort welded together, powered only, gated by a research project hidden until a mat is first seen), the refining recipe, Deepfire itself (a resource that glows faintly in a stockpile), and the GlowTank (a slow, low-yield cultured source). Every number is a Mod Settings toggle; the whole gate can be turned to Buildable or Unbuildable instead of Research.
THIS BUILD ALSO SHIPS (DEEPFIRE_PAINT_STATUS_CUISINE_1, partial): Cuisine's 14 glow-hediff families (§6) with 15 recipes on any stove and the chef-skill-steered outcome mechanism; the Ninefold god bridge (§5) wired for the two events that do not need painting (a dish eaten; the vermilion family reaching tier III); and the sumptuary "purple engine" (§4) as a real, generic, currently-inert reusable system (its own thoughts fire once something is tagged with RM_StatusGoodExtension — nothing is yet).
STILL NOT IN THIS BUILD — filed as DEEPFIRE_PAINT_LIVE_VERIFY_1: painting Deepfire onto walls, floors, furniture, art, apparel and weapons (the designator/comp/beauty-and-quality mechanism, §3) and worn Deepfire's moving light with its darkness-targeting combat tradeoff (§3.4). Both need the spec's own live proxy-glower quicktest (§10 step 1) before anything else may be built on the light-proxy shape it decides, plus (for the combat tradeoff) a live bridge comparison of ShotReport.HitReportFor numbers the spec's own build plan calls for (§10 step 8) — not owner- blocked, but genuinely needing a live game, not a def dump. The gods' coat/sold/statue-coat deltas and the status engine's room-stat thoughts (RM_DeepfireBedroom, RM_ImpressedByDeepfire) wait on CompDeepfire from that same follow-on, not a new design question.
The Scald's Utinni-tier sourcing (the bottom-walkers laying crowncarpet as they pass, and the Stillfluid/Thornwillow fixative recipe) is a patch in the Utinni layer, not this mod — this mod is francise-free and fully functional (wild shore spawn) with the Scald absent.
